strings.name: Cristiano Ronaldo
strings.summary: Ronaldo developed from Madeira’s youth football into a prolific scorer across major leagues. Five Ballons d’Or and five Champions League titles underpin his global influence. He helped Portugal win the European Championship and two Nations Leagues, ending his international career in 2026 while continuing a distinct club career.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026. Selected milestones; competitions, affiliations and records refer to their cited dates, not an exhaustive match log.
strings.influence.rationale: Multiple Ballon d’Or awards, sporting achievements and a career across continents have expanded football’s global reach.

strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Club achievements
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Won five Champions Leagues; became Real Madrid’s all-time leading scorer during nine seasons.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: National honours
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Helped Portugal win Euro 2016 and the Nations League in 2019 and 2025.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Portugal retirement
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Announced his international retirement, distinct from retirement from club football.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Another Nations League
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Portugal defeated Spain in the final to secure its second title.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Joined Al-Nassr
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Began playing in Saudi Arabia, extending his club career beyond Europe.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Manchester United return
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Left Juventus and returned to the club where he first achieved global prominence.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Moved to Juventus
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Ended nine years at Real Madrid and continued his career in Italy.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: European champion
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Portugal beat France; injury forced him out early in the final.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Joined Real Madrid
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Transferred from Manchester United, beginning nine seasons in Madrid.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: First Ballon d’Or
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Won the Champions League with Manchester United and his first Ballon d’Or.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: United and Portugal debuts
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Moved from Sporting to United and made his senior Portugal debut that year.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Sporting academy
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Left Madeira aged twelve to train in Lisbon.
strings.timeline.event-11.title: Born in Funchal
strings.timeline.event-11.text: Born on Portugal’s Madeira island, where he began playing football.
